name: Tool — Web IQ (1P MCP)
summary: Microsoft 1P MCP server: Web IQ (web search/grounding via MCP).
description: Web IQ is exposed as an MCP-style tool that can provide web-derived context to a Prompt Agent while the host orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. This covers web intelligence scenarios distinct from Bing Grounding and OpenAI-native web search.
notes:
Verified end-to-end when `WEB_IQ_MCP_URL` points at a Web IQ MCP server. See `test.py`.

Web IQ is not in the official BYOM-supported tools list; only Foundry IQ is listed among the 1P MCP servers. Official list: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations.
